post_title: Hiring Your First Intern as a Startup

captions.linkedin:
Hiring your first intern as a startup? Start here.

A startup internship can be one of the best learning experiences a student gets, if you set it up well:

1. Pick one clear project with a visible outcome
2. Cover the basics: right to work, written terms, insurance
3. Sell the startup experience: responsibility and access to founders
4. Hire for attitude, not a long CV
5. Make time to mentor, even 30 minutes a week
6. Plan the ending: a final presentation, a reference, an open door

Save this for when you make your first hire.

Find your first intern at internwise.co.uk/employers
